High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Jeevan Singh Gurjar - advocate for the appellan
 Shri Tarun Pagare, Govt. Advocate for the respondent

1. Heard on I.A. No.4753/2025, fourth application under Section 430(1) of BNSS 2023 for temporary suspension of sentence moved on behalf of appellant on the ground of marriage of his neice scheduled from 10.04.2025 to 14.04.2025.
2.
Appellant has been convicted for offence under Sections 376(2)(i) of IPC,1860 and sentenced to undergo 10 years R.I. with fine and usual default stipulations.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submitted that the marriage of appellant's niece is going to solemnize from 10.04.2025 to 14.04.2025.
Appellant has already completed 6 years of sentence out of 10 years R.I.
Therefore, prays for grant of temporary suspension for a period of 15 days.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State as well as counsel for the objector have opposed the prayer, however, submitted that temporarily suspension shall be granted subject to verification through trial Court.
5. On due consideration, prayer for temporary suspension of jail sentence of appellant is allowed.

6. The sentence of the appellant is temporarily suspended for a period 2 CRA-5465-2021 of 15 days from the date of his release after verification of marriage by the trial Court on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court, and an undertaking that he will surrender himself on completion of 15 days for serving the remaining jail sentence.
In case of non-surrender, the learned trial Court shall be free to take any coercive action against the appellant to ensure his surrender before the trial Court.
7. A copy of this order be sent to the learned Court below concerned for information and necessary compliance.
